In particular, this action will strengthen the EU¿s bilateral and multilateral engagement with Argentina, Colombia and five countries[1] in Southeast Asia on the external impacts of EU Green Deal policies and regulatory frameworks with a special focus on deforestation and forest degradation.[1] Indonesia, Malaysia, Laos, Thailand, and Vietnam
